messages.subject: File upload to shinyapp.io issue
parts:
Hi everyone,

       I am hoping to get some advice on a file upload limitation I get with a deployed app on shinyapp.io. The app works fine locally on my computer. Specifically, I can only upload very small files (e.g. 7KB), but my uploader fails at even 83K csv files. I have set the file upload size option, even though the default should be fine.
       The problem is replicated on the file upload demo site here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/upload-file.html. I can upload this file, which is 7KB, but not this one, which is 83K. The file structures are the same--the second one just has more rows of data. The larger one gives an error, which I can read on the javascript console: "requesty (sic) body in temp file not supported." It does the same thing in Chrome and IE for me. Is this a limitation on my account at shinyapp.io? I can't find out anything about that on the site.

Regards,

dave
